news.headline: General Code and American Legal Publishing Unite as ICC Code Solutions

paragraphs: American Legal Publishing helps communities publish and give access to their municipal codes, ordinances and related information. Its partnerships run to municipal, county, state and tribal jurisdictions, as well as municipal leagues and associations.

Codes are published online for round-the-clock digital access to a jurisdiction's code content. A separate service digitizes documents and records so they can be searched. Zoning work covers code content published together with maps. On the building side, local amendments are folded into the International Codes. A research offering reaches nearly 4,000 municipal codes.

The site announces that American Legal Publishing and General Code are uniting under a new brand. That union is presented as pooling the codification experience of both firms. The combined brand sits inside ICC Innovation, an initiative bringing together digital tools for professional development, community growth and code compliance.
